name: sori
description: Sori: podcasts and YouTube into transcripts, then into training decks. Mac, Linux, Windows.

plugins.name: sori
plugins.description: Sori on any OS from Claude Code, Claude Desktop or Cowork, no app to install. Transcripts: /sori:setup, /sori:transcribe, /sori:shows, /sori:sweep. Training pipeline: /sori:curate (triage, L&D brief, critic; maker != checker) and /sori:design (brief to deck through offline pptx, Claude Design, d_sign HTML, ChatSlide or Figma); /sori:train is the one-shot deck. Free by default; the API route is optional and paid.
